summary: No demonstrated defect in the audited package. All eight checks passed within the saved source, captured-inventory and finite-sampling limits; package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Identify homogeneous versus inhomogeneous first-order linear ODEs after collecting all dependent-variable terms on the left.
reasoning_steps: Read whether homogeneous or inhomogeneous is requested.
For RHS zero, recognize homogeneous standard form.
For RHS a multiple of y, transfer it left and combine coefficients.
For nonzero constant or monomial forcing, recognize it is not identically zero, even if zero at individual x values.
Apply the requested class independently to each checkbox.
invariants: First-order linear ODEs with derivative coefficient 1 in observed bank.
Three independently classified equations; exact forcing identity test after collecting y terms.
Every answer field and solution must follow equation and requested class.
Preserve full source banks and all-homogeneous easy case.
permitted_variations: Change signed small integer coefficients and low-degree monomial P(x), nonzero forcing constants/monomials, and y multiples.
Change order and assignments of homogeneous versus nonhomogeneous roles to the three equations; eligible response counts must not be fixed merely because common source examples use two selections.
Within difficulty preserve easy homogeneous versus moderate inhomogeneous request unless a justified extension is stated.
Changing P(x) alone or a nonzero coefficient of a pure y RHS is irrelevant to class; changing pure-y RHS into a forcing term changes class.
Conservatively allow same-workload bank profiles composed from the observed equation forms; no new ODE solving skill.

source_replay.details: All 12 supported source banks replay exact prompts, solutions, field keys, full true/false choices and keys after shared presentation normalization. Canonical II-only mathematics checked; unavailable original controls explicitly documented.

math.details: Exact independent SymPy checks on 602 raw/replay/pair/batch records: displayed forcing, truth keys, every concrete solution transformation, and conclusion. Includes coefficient cancellation and signed boundaries.

variety.details: 63 role profiles and 512 independent fresh seeds; all supported decision profiles survive actual captured-inventory filtering. Delivery and weighted-selection/history scenarios separately examined with stated limits.

scope.details: Same three-equation forcing-identity recognition, one/two y transfers, observed target/difficulty mapping. No solving, nonlinear recognition, new response types or hard normalization extension.

grading.details: Native grade_field: 1,139 records including 537 post-delivery records; 3,417 correct responses accepted and 3,417 wrong responses rejected, no unresolved cases. Choice-based checkbox contract; free-entry equivalence inapplicable.

rendering.details: Nine actual UI previews, all inspected: relevant/irrelevant/target pairs, cancellation, source all-selected bank and runner record. No math, JS, glyph or image errors.

packaging.details: Manifest-only relocation works outside repository import context with deterministic output. Exact Python 3.13.5 and SymPy 1.14.0 match declaration. All 153 workspace files unchanged; no assets/publication/database writes.

decision_variation.details: Independently assessed role assignments and constraints; controlled relevant and irrelevant changes verified in math, actual grading and rendering. Fixed positions/counts and degree/sign/template cue groups do not supply a reliable bypass in audited samples.
